TC-04/S27.productIssue: Narrow window, low severity: if a Quick Dictation box is assigned to a patient whose encounter was last edited more than 18 h ago and the app has not run its lifecycle pass since the 18 h mark, the box is appended to yesterday's encounter text — the physician sees 'Day 1: …' above today's words in today's encounter (it would go into today's note) and yesterday's text is never kept as a transcript. Window: the app runs rounding:applyLifecycle on every load and every 10 min while open (AppLayout.tsx ContextLifecycle, no run on return to the foreground), so it needs a tab or phone left open across the 18 h mark and an assign before the next pass — at most ~10 min with the app in the foreground (longer if a backgrounded phone's timer was paused). Breaks UAT 3.6 (encounter 18 h, then yesterday's transcript) / TC-04 U2. Mechanism: quickDictation:assign appends and restarts encounterEditedAt without applying the 18 h rollover itself.
